page.layout: One page of text, one column, with a heading centred above it. No margin notes. Running text ends with a signature word "Ami-" at the lower right.

main_text.head: Admonitio.
main_text.p: communicationem, non solúm esse humana figmenta, ut pote à sacra scriptura & ratione abhorrentia, sed & fuisse, esse & futura tamdiu res perniciofissimas Orbi Christiano, quoad Deus liberaverit mentes Regum, Magistratuum & Theologorum istis deliramentis: De quibus ut de totius controversiæ complexu nihil scripsit Frater,sed rem in medio reliquit ; haud dubium tamen in præsenti lite quæ mihi est cum magno & celeberrimo Theologo, non futurùs otiofus spectator, sed calculos positurus, ut id eligat in quo vicerit ratio.

page.notes: Lower-case long s printed as s, read as plain s. Some words in the scan are blurred ("futurùs", "complexu") and transcribed as printed. The word "Ami-" is a line-end catchword-like fragment of "Amicus" and is kept as printed.
